tips.dialect: Applies only to newly imported files. Click a file’s version tag to change its dialect.
tips.generateMode: Error handling strategy. strict: stop on unsupported syntax or errors; permissive: output as much as possible. CLI: --generate-mode / -g
tips.parseMode: Parser strictness. strict: strict validation; permissive: tolerate non-standard bytecode. CLI: --parse-mode / -p
tips.stringEncoding: Encoding for string constant decoding. auto detects common legacy encodings. CLI: --encoding / -e
tips.stringDecodeMode: Behavior on string decode failure. strict: error; lossy: replace with placeholders. CLI: --decode-mode / -m
tips.ignoreDebug: Parse and validate debug sections, but exclude them from recovery and generated comments. CLI: --ignore-debug
tips.returnInlineMaxComplexity: Max inline expression complexity in return statements. CLI: --return-inline-max-complexity
tips.indexInlineMaxComplexity: Max inline expression complexity in table index expressions. CLI: --index-inline-max-complexity
tips.argsInlineMaxComplexity: Max inline expression complexity in call arguments. CLI: --args-inline-max-complexity
tips.accessBaseInlineMaxComplexity: Max inline expression complexity in table access bases. CLI: --access-base-inline-max-complexity
tips.namingMode: All modes prefer debug names. Fallback: debug-like uses numbered names; simple uses generic names and basic roles; heuristic uses expressions, field usage, module paths and call names. CLI: --naming-mode / -n
tips.debugLikeIncludeFunction: Include the function index in debug-like names. CLI: --debug-like-include-function
tips.maxLineLength: Preferred maximum line length for generated code. CLI: --max-line-length
tips.readableStrings: Enabled by default: emit decoded text as UTF-8. Disable to preserve original bytes. The string encoding setting specifies the input encoding. CLI: --readable-strings
tips.quoteStyle: String quote style. prefer-double: prefer "; prefer-single: prefer '; min-escape: minimize escapes. CLI: --quote-style
tips.numberFormat: Number literal style. decimal: regular numbers; hex: emit integer literals as 0x... when possible. CLI: --number-format
tips.tableStyle: Table constructor layout. compact: single line; balanced: auto; aligned: space-aligned grid for small homogeneous arrays; expanded: one entry per line. CLI: --table-style
tips.luauVectorConstructor: Render Luau vector constants with an explicit constructor and 3D/4D size. The library is optional; constructor and size are required. CLI: --luau-vector-library / --luau-vector-constructor / --luau-vector-size
tips.comment: Comment verbosity. minimal: header and source line numbers; full: per-proto metadata stats; none: omit comments. CLI: --comment
tips.tableDropIndexKeys: Omit safe sequential [1] = ..., [2] = ... integer keys in PUC Lua table initializers. CLI: --table-drop-index-keys
tips.tableAlignEq: Align `=` across adjacent keys in multi-line aligned record tables. CLI: --table-align-eq
tips.tableAlignEqMaxSpaces: Maximum padding spaces before `=` when aligning record keys (0 disables). CLI: --table-align-eq-max-spaces
tips.tableAlignCells: Cell alignment for aligned grids: auto right-aligns numbers and left-aligns other primitives. CLI: --table-align-cells
tips.tableAlignWidth: Maximum line width for aligned tables (empty inherits Max Line Length). CLI: --table-align-width
tips.tableAlignStringWidth: Maximum rendered string literal width allowed inside an aligned grid. CLI: --table-align-string-width

about.title: About
about.summary: Analyze and decompile Lua bytecode directly in your browser
about.description: unluac-web is built on top of unluac-rs and WebAssembly for quickly inspecting decompiled output, comparing results, and drilling into Proto / CFG views when you need more structure.

multiDialect.title: Multi-version, multi-dialect support
multiDialect.description: Covers Lua 5.1–5.5, LuaJIT, and Luau, with parser and generator behavior configurable per target dialect.

localFirst.title: Runs fully on-device
localFirst.description: Decompilation and analysis happen inside the current browser via WebAssembly, without uploading bytecode to a server.

tooling.title: More than plain source output
tooling.description: Alongside source code, you can batch process files, compare outputs, and inspect structured Proto / CFG analysis.

presets.title: Presets
presets.hint: Apply a common output profile without changing dialect or string encoding.

readable.label: Readable
readable.description: Heuristic names, minimal comments, aligned tables, and clean array keys.

exact.label: Exact
exact.description: Strict parse/generate, raw byte strings, numbered names, and full comments.

ai.label: For AI
ai.description: Heuristic names, minimal comments, and compact tables to save tokens.
